steps.u: Can you review the diff for the new modal component? Accessibility is what I care about.

steps.a: Missing: role dialog and aria-modal, an accessible name, focus moved into the dialog on open and restored on close, focus trapped inside, and Escape to close. Clicking the backdrop closes it but keyboard users have no equivalent.

i.content: Use the native dialog element or add role/aria-modal, focus trap, Escape handling, focus restore. Add tests for keyboard behaviour.

reference.summary: Reviewed a modal component for accessibility and found no dialog role, no focus management or trap, and no keyboard close; recommended the native dialog element and keyboard tests.

decisions.reason: it provides focus handling and escape behaviour by default
